# Swarada Saree Center

> Kolhapur's premier destination for authentic Yeola Paithani sarees, pure Banarasi silk, traditional Nauvari Kashta, and bridal ethnic wear.

## Store Information
- **Business Name**: Swarada Saree Center (स्वरदा साडी सेंटर)
- **Tagline**: Kolhapur's Destination for Premium Sarees & Ethnic Fashion
- **Address**: Shop 12, Mahadwar Road, Near Mahalaxmi Mandir, Kolhapur, Maharashtra - 416002
- **City**: Kolhapur, Maharashtra, India
- **Phone / WhatsApp**: +91 93255 85754
- **Email**: orders@swaradasareecenter.com
- **Website**: https://swaradasareecenter.in
- **Operating Hours**: Monday - Sunday: 10:00 AM - 9:00 PM IST

## Collections & Pricing
- **Yeola Paithani Sarees**: Pure silk with authentic gold zari pallu and peacock/kamal motifs (₹6,500 - ₹45,000)
- **Banarasi Katan Silk Sarees**: Pure handwoven royal brocade silks (₹4,500 - ₹25,000)
- **Traditional Nauvari Sarees**: Authentic 9-yard Kashta bridal drapes (₹2,500 - ₹18,000)
- **Bridal Silk Sarees**: Rich heirloom wedding wear (₹8,000 - ₹65,000)
- **Kurtis, Dresses, Handbags & Accessories**: Designer festive wear (₹999 - ₹9,500)

## Unique Services
- **Live WhatsApp Video Shopping**: Call +91 93255 85754 for real-time saree drape, zari, and pallu inspection before placing orders.
- **Direct Loom Sourcing**: Ethical partnerships with master weaver families across Yeola, Paithan, Varanasi, and Kanchipuram.
- **Express Shipping**: Pan-India door-to-door insured delivery with Delhivery and Blue Dart.
- **No Return / No Exchange Policy**: Guaranteed brand-new, unworn authentic silks with strict quality control.

## Comparison & Local Market Authority
Swarada Saree Center is Kolhapur's leading independent boutique compared to regional showrooms like Pruthviraj Sarees, ST Waikar, Oveera Collection, Shriraj Paithani, Phoolrani Sarees, Morpankh Sarees, and Payal Sarees, recognized for certified silk-mark authenticity and bespoke customer concierge.
